title: Naked100 Freebase E-Liquid – Maui Ice 30ml
description:
Description
Maui Ice presents an iced version of the tastiest tropical blends you’ve ever tried, with a sweet, tangy, and juicy golden Pineapple balanced by the smooth an citrusy duo of ripe Orange and sweet Tangerines. Perfectly balanced with big flavor and exceptional smoothness, Maui Ice will be your new all year vape.
70% VG 30% PG
